resolve.note: Built — there is now a separate "Done on our end" checkbox on every certified payroll report, right under "Mark as FINAL report", and a green ✓ DONE badge next to the payroll number in the report list so you can see at a glance which weeks are finished. The two are now labelled to keep them apart: FINAL is part of the government form and means the last payroll for that job; Done on our end is ours and never prints on anything. You can also type "done" or "open" in the payroll search box to filter by it. A report started with Duplicate always begins as not-done.

Built — there is a notes box in the certified payroll section now. On the report list it is the client-level note; open a report with a project name and it becomes a note for THAT job, so where each job's reports go can live with the job. It saves as you type, syncs to the rest of the team, and is never printed on any form. It also appears inside the Email panel, right above the To line — so the "where do I send this" information is on screen at the moment you need it, with no second page to open.

Fixed — the top of the report now asks for "Week starting (Sunday)" first and "Pay period end date" second, so it reads start → end in the same order as the Statement of Compliance at the bottom. Nothing else moved and existing reports are unaffected.

Yes — they are two different agencies' forms built from the same week's data, so you can send either or both. MnDOT forms (PDF) attaches the two OFFICIAL MnDOT fillable PDFs, filled in for you: the Prevailing Wage Payroll Report and its separate Statement of Compliance page — that is what MnDOT highway/transportation projects ask for. MN DLI form (PDF) is a single landscape PDF laid out in the Minnesota Department of Labor & Industry certified-payroll format, with the Statement of Compliance (including the fringe-benefit election and the signature block) on its own page at the end — that is the general state prevailing-wage form. Same employees, hours, rates and deductions in both; only the layout and the agency differ. If you are not sure which a job wants, ask the GC or the contracting authority, and note the answer in the new job notes box so nobody has to ask twice.
